key_reasoning.reason: Touches Thought and ThoughtHeader shared components, ChatAiMessage (plus new thoughtView factory), ChatPrompt blocking, the chatGeneration store resume flow, the api stream layer (StreamOptions.errorToast), chatHelpers, and a new thoughtTree utility, all within the chat subsystem of a single frontend repo. New abstractions exist but stay in one subsystem, so L rather than XL.

Extends the existing tool-call resume and workflow-resume streaming pattern to nested thought trees (recursive pending/decided/abandoned step detection, ancestor Waiting status, forced expansion) plus a per-status resume error policy (refetch vs restore buttons, toast suppression). Base M, bumped for the streaming resume path.

25 files changed (2292 insertions, 202 deletions): roughly 11 production files modified, 2 new production files (thoughtTree.ts, thoughtView.tsx), and about 13 test files including new resume/toolCall suites and a shared fixtures file, across src/components, src/pages, src/store, src/types, src/utils plus vite.config.ts.

Behaviour is spec-driven (resume error table keyed by backend constants), but follow-up commits addressing review findings and keeping decided steps expanded until resume indicate some gaps resolved during implementation.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: streaming requirement (tool-call resume consumes a streamed response)
